status.main_product: Advanced mapping, survey, 3D Digital Twin, and LiDAR geospatial services
status.scope_reason: The company provides drone surveys, aerial LiDAR acquisition, and photogrammetry mapping services under its own brand.
status.evidence: Genesys International secured a project for the Aerial LiDAR Survey and Geotagged Videography of the River Ganga's drainage system employing UAVs/drones as reported by Manufacturing Today in May 2026.

claims.claim: The company reports having a sizeable fleet of high-definition LiDAR scanning systems across terrestrial, backpack, mobile, and aerial platforms, and it has developed partnerships with leading flying operators for airborne LiDAR surveys using fixed-wing aircraft, helicopters, and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs).

In May 2026, the company secured a major project from the National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG) for aerial LiDAR mapping and geotagged videography along the Ganga corridor, utilizing a combination of manned aerial platforms and UAVs/drones to capture high-resolution point clouds and orthorectified imagery.

Genesys International Corporation Limited developed an indigenously owned 3D Digital Twin Map Stack and proprietary solutions like InfraSCAPE, which provide point cloud processing, 3D mesh model generation, DEM/DSM APIs, and infrastructure asset condition evaluations.
claims.note: Point cloud processing, 3D mesh model generation, and DEM/DSM APIs are not explicitly listed features of the InfraSCAPE solution.

claims.claim: In projects like the Varanasi Smart City 3D digital twin (which received the SKOCH Gold Award) and other urban mapping programs, the company reports deploying its proprietary platforms and workflow integrations—such as AI-driven automation pipelines—to process raw sensor data into reality mesh models and dense point clouds.
claims.note: The deployment of AI-driven automation pipelines specifically for the Varanasi Smart City project to process raw sensor data is unconfirmed in published project details.

claims.claim: Genesys International Corporation Limited reports that its high-definition (HD) and Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) maps achieve an absolute accuracy of 5 centimetres.
For its 3D Digital Twin solutions, the company states that its sensor constellation captures data with centimetre-level resolution, delineating building footprints and urban terrain attributes.

claims.parameter: R&D and Innovation in Surveying Tech
claims.claim: The company reports that it filed for the registration of two patents in November 2021, including one that covers a process for the automatic extraction of street furniture from panoramic imagery and LiDAR data using AI/ML automation techniques.

Genesys International Corporation Limited secured a contract from the National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG) in May 2026 to conduct an aerial LiDAR survey and geotagged videography using manned platforms and drones/UAVs along the Ganga corridor.

The company won a ₹17.38 crore contract from Bureau Veritas in December 2025 to deploy high-precision LiDAR systems and 3D Ground Penetrating Radar for subsurface mapping across six Adani Group airports.

The company reported standalone revenue of ₹70.11 crore for the fourth quarter of the financial year 2024 (Q4FY24), representing a 48% increase from ₹47.39 crore in the same quarter of the previous year.

The company reported overall quarterly revenues of ₹78.44 crore for the quarter ended March 2026, driven in part by its core mapping offerings such as LiDAR-based mapping, 3D city modeling, and smart city geospatial projects, alongside a net loss per share of ₹-0.49.

The company has executed pan-India drone and aerial LiDAR mapping projects, including a 3D subsurface Ground Penetrating Radar survey across multiple Adani Group airports (Mumbai, Trivandrum, Lucknow, Jaipur, Guwahati, and Ahmedabad), a 2,500-km Ganga corridor project spanning four states (Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, and West Bengal), and 3D urban digital twin mapping in Kashi (Varanasi).

Genesys International Corporation Limited signed a strategic alliance with the Survey of India to develop high-precision 3D Digital Twins of major cities by combining the company's LiDAR and sensor constellation with the national authority's 902 Continuously Operating Reference Stations (CORS) network.

The company announced a strategic partnership with SatSure to integrate its 3D mapping and LiDAR data processing expertise with SatSure's satellite remote sensing and AI-driven platforms across utilities, aviation, forestry, and disaster management.

The company reports developing highly accurate, fully navigable road datasets encompassing 8.5 million kilometers, 40 million Points of Interest (POIs), and an unprecedented 1 million kilometers of 360-degree panoramic imagery across Indian towns and cities using its own constellation of LiDAR and optical sensors.

The company reports completing over 75,000 km of road mapping, 3,000 km of railroad corridor mapping, and mapping the top 100 Indian cities covering 30,000 square kilometers under its 3D Digital Twin content program.
claims.corrected: The company reports completing over 75,000 km of road mapping, 3,000 km of railroad corridor mapping, and mapping the top 100 Indian cities under its 3D Digital Twin content program.
claims.note: The details regarding over 75,000 km of road mapping and 3,000 km of railroad corridor mapping are officially achieved milestones under their LiDAR engineering services rather than specifically stated under the 3D Digital Twin content program banner, and the specific constraint of "covering 30,000 square kilometers" is unverified.
claims.source: Genesys International Official Website (LiDAR Engineering and 3D Digital Twin program details)

status.main_product: UAV photogrammetric mapping and LiDAR processing services
status.scope_reason: The company specializes in delivering drone photogrammetry topographic mapping, digital orthophotography, and LiDAR post-processing data services.
status.evidence: According to the company's official website and LinkedIn profile, Earth On Mapping Consulting is an active geospatial firm offering UAV photogrammetry and LiDAR data processing services.

claims.claim: The company reports executing over 250,000 km of LiDAR powerline classification/mapping and 78,000+ aerial and UAV triangulation projects.
The company reports that all final products are checked twice for content and accuracy under the supervision of a Certified Photogrammetrist with over 12 years of experience.
claims.note: The detail regarding all final products being checked twice under the supervision of a Certified Photogrammetrist with over 12 years of experience is not confirmed by the company's published profiles.

claims.claim: The company reports providing terrain mapping accuracy up to 2 feet and high-definition digital topography map scales of 1:100000.
claims.note: The specific claims stating terrain mapping accuracy up to 2 feet and high-definition digital topography map scales of 1:100000 are not explicitly published in official sources.

claims.claim: The company reports aggregated operational processing metrics of over 2,000,000 kilometres of LiDAR power line projects, 300,000 square kilometres of bathymetric LiDAR surveys, and 1,500,000 square kilometres of DTM/DSM classification.

The company reports serving a diverse client base globally, including private and government agencies across municipalities, transport, railways, power, hydro, mining, oil and gas, and telecom industries.

The company reports executing projects that include over 250,000 km of powerline classification/mapping, 2,000 km of road mapping, 1,500 km of railway mapping, and 78,000+ aerial and UAV triangulation flights.
